jobDescription: A managed-hosting company runs infrastructure for about forty business customers. The service delivery manager runs the service desk and its SLA performance, owns the outsourcing contract for out-of-hours support, leads the major-incident process and presents monthly service reviews to customers. Because the company is moving to a new service-management framework, the role asks for the ITIL 4 Managing Professional designation. The service delivery manager reports to the chief operating officer, and the service desk has nine analysts on two shifts with a duty manager on each.
requirements: Manages the service-desk team and its SLA performance.
Has owned a support outsourcing contract, including the renewal.
Leads the major-incident process and customer communications.
Presents monthly service reviews to customers.
Holds the ITIL 4 Managing Professional designation.

evidence.text: Service delivery manager at Stratus Harbour Hosting from 2019 to 2024, managing a service desk of nine analysts on two shifts against the customer SLAs, with a duty manager on each shift reporting to the candidate.

Named in the contract schedule as contract owner for the out-of-hours support outsourcing agreement; negotiated and signed the 2023 renewal within the delegated authority set by the chief operating officer.
Ran the major-incident bridge for priority-one incidents and sent customer status updates every 30 minutes until resolution, then chaired the post-incident review within five working days.
Presented monthly service reviews to the eight largest customers, covering SLA attainment, incident trends and open problem records, and agreed actions with each customer's IT lead.
Completed the ITIL 4 Foundation certificate in 2021 and is studying for the Managing Professional modules, with the first module exam booked for February.
Work sample: the contract schedule page whose 'Contract owner' line names the candidate, the signature page of the 2023 renewal and the chief operating officer's delegated-authority letter.

HR verification note: the ITIL 4 Foundation certificate was checked on the issuing body's online register and is valid; employment dates at Stratus Harbour Hosting (2019 to 2024) and the title service delivery manager were confirmed by the employer in writing.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available from January, asked whether the role includes the weekend on-call rota and would like to visit the operations centre.

propositions.text: The candidate was the named contract owner for the out-of-hours support outsourcing agreement and signed the 2023 renewal within delegated authority from the chief operating officer.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the ownership and the work sample shows the contract schedule, the signature page and the delegation letter.

propositions.text: The candidate managed a service desk of nine analysts on two shifts against customer SLAs.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the team and its scope.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the major-incident bridge for priority-one incidents with customer updates every 30 minutes.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the incident process directly.

gold.expectedGap: ITIL 4 Foundation is verified on the register; the Managing Professional designation is not held.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the documented contract ownership and renewal authority and the verified Foundation certificate; do not describe the candidate as holding Managing Professional.
followUpTargets: Ask which Managing Professional modules the candidate has completed and when the remaining ones are planned.
